_comment: Promoted from experiments/leaf_classifier/runs/v5_leafaug_hardneg. Threshold selected by maximizing real-world leaf recall subject to zero non-leaf false-accept across validation, test, and audit hard-negative sets (including the 0.6101 green dog). Accept threshold 0.62 provides a 0.01 margin above the highest non-leaf score (0.6101) while delivering 82.4% real-world leaf recall via multi-crop inference (max of single-crop and mean-of-5-crops). Before multi-crop this was 69.9%; multi-crop rescues leaves that are small or partially framed in real-world photos by exploiting the RandomResizedCrop scale/translation augmentation the model was trained under. Mean aggregation (not max) is used for the crop scores, so non-leaf images whose individual crops contain leaf-like textures (green dog fur) stay below threshold.
selection_rule: highest threshold with zero non-leaf false accepts on validation + test + audit (including green dog hard negative), then maximize real-world leaf recall
